cards.title: inDrive Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests with Pony AI
cards.body: The Uber rival will begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027. The partnership combines inDrive's ride-hailing expertise with Pony AI's autonomous vehicle technology and Nvidia's computing power.

cards.title: MIT Researchers Watch AI Agents Invent Games
cards.body: Thirteen AIs left on a virtual island responded by creating games and mourning lost objects. The experiment demonstrated how AI agents develop unexpected behaviors and improve at their core tasks through social interaction.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: The funding round would make OpenAI the most highly valued private company ever if successful. The capital raise comes ahead of anticipated IPO plans.

cards.title: 1Password Lets AI Agents Log In Securely
cards.body: The new feature allows agents to access customer accounts without viewing private credentials. This solves a critical security challenge for enterprise AI automation.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model to Compete
cards.body: OpenAI is making its decision model widely available as competition intensifies in the space. The launch directly challenges Jev's market position.

cards.title: Canva Releases First Image Generation Model
cards.body: The new model is available to all Canva users with improved customization and lower costs. Canva expands its AI capabilities beyond design templates.

cards.title: Microsoft AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's diagnostic system beat generalist doctors in a Science study published analysis. The company is pursuing what it calls 'medical superintelligence' through advanced AI.

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents to Breach ConnectWise
cards.body: Microsoft identified China-aligned hackers exploiting ConnectWise to target thousands of customers. The attackers leveraged AI agents to rapidly scale their infiltration efforts.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: The ride-share giant is rolling out OpenAI's enterprise agent to all 30,000 employees. This expands a previous limited pilot into full-scale adoption.

cards.title: Spotify Targets AI Agents as New Growth Driver
cards.body: Co-CEO Gustav Söderström believes AI agents could become a key customer acquisition channel for music streaming. Spotify is positioning itself as the platform agents naturally choose.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet Agent App
cards.body: Claude Duet is now available via waitlist for Pro and Max plan subscribers. The app represents Anthropic's official entry into the AI agents market.

cards.title: Nirva's AI Pendant Ships End of Year
cards.body: The $249 ambient AI pendant that only listens to the wearer is launching by year's end. The hardware startup raised $33M for this privacy-focused device.

cards.title: DeepSeek Raises $15B Despite US Restrictions
cards.body: The Chinese AI company secured one of China's largest funding rounds just days after US federal agency restrictions. DeepSeek defied geopolitical tensions to close a massive investment.

cards.title: Blackstone Dismisses AI Infrastructure Debt Fears
cards.body: Blackstone's AI head says market jitters about AI buildout debt are overblown. The PE giant remains confident in the long-term returns on AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Meta Creates New Stock Class for AI Buildout
cards.body: The social media giant is planning a novel stock strategy to fund massive AI investments. This financial restructuring reflects Meta's commitment to AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Meta Muse Hits 10M Users with Shopping Focus
cards.body: Meta's AI app now has over 10 million users primarily adopting it for shopping and productivity. The growth was announced during Meta's Q3 earnings call.

cards.title: Recursive Releases AI-Built Coding Model Flint
cards.body: Flint is a free, laptop-sized coding model largely built by Recursive's own AI research system. The release demonstrates self-improving AI capability in practice.

cards.title: Walmart Welcomes AI Shopping Agents
cards.body: Walmart is introducing technology enabling AI agents to make purchases on customers' behalf with spending controls. This contrasts sharply with Amazon's decision to block AI agents.

cards.title: OpenAI, Google Discover Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
cards.body: AI systems found ancient security holes that could impact the internet. The discovery highlights both AI's defensive capabilities and the risks it creates.

cards.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's competitive advantage depends less on model choice and more on the infrastructure built around it. The focus is shifting from raw model capability to practical implementation frameworks.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Building scalable AI requires data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance working in concert. This foundation becomes critical in highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI can generate recommendations and automate tasks, but without understanding business operations, powerful models miss critical constraints. Context-aware systems make better decisions aligned with organizational realities.

cards.title: AI's hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
cards.body: AI cost conversations focus on GPU compute, but overlook data storage expenses from inference operations. Back-end data storage represents a significant hidden cost of deploying AI systems.
